title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) — official guidance
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
content: PMFBY is the Government of India crop-insurance scheme administered through the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare. The official PMFBY portal publishes the 2023 Operational Guidelines, crop calendars, insurer and bank-branch directories, and official help channels. Coverage, notified crops, insurance units, cut-off dates, premiums, eligibility, loss reporting and claim procedures can vary by season, State or Union Territory and the applicable notification. A farmer should use the current State notification and the official PMFBY portal for those details. For a grievance, use the official PMFBY help or feedback channel and retain the policy/application details. This record deliberately does not state a fixed premium, crop list, deadline, claim timeline, or coverage amount because these must be verified against current official notifications.

title: PM-KISAN — official scheme portal
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
content: PM-KISAN is a Central Sector scheme administered by the Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare. The official portal provides current scheme guidance, registration, beneficiary status, helpdesk and revised operational guidelines. The portal states that eligibility and exclusion categories are governed by the scheme guidelines and that the State Government or Union Territory administration identifies eligible farmer families. Check the official portal before acting because eligibility, registration requirements and verification status must be current.

title: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) — official scheme directory
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
content: The Kisan Credit Card scheme is designed to provide adequate and timely credit support through the banking system for agricultural operations and related needs. The official scheme directory describes cultivation, post-harvest expenses, marketing, farm-asset working capital and agriculture/allied investment credit as covered purposes. It says implementing banks apply operational requirements and should be consulted for current eligibility, documentation, credit limits, security and interest terms. Cooperative Mitra provides general education only and cannot apply for, approve, or access a KCC account.

title: Soil Health Card Scheme — official FAQ
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
content: The Soil Health Card Scheme is a Government of India scheme implemented through State and Union Territory agriculture departments. The official FAQ explains that a Soil Health Card reports the nutrient status of a farmer's holding and provides fertilizer and soil-amendment advice. Use the official Soil Health Card portal or the relevant agriculture office for current sample collection, laboratory, tracking and local implementation information.

title: National Agriculture Market (e-NAM) — official portal
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
content: e-NAM is a pan-India electronic trading portal that networks participating APMC mandis to support a unified national market for agricultural commodities. The official portal identifies SFAC as the lead implementing agency under the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare. Registration, mandi participation, commodities and trading requirements are official-portal and State/APMC specific; users should verify them directly with e-NAM.

title: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF) — official reference
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
content: The Agriculture Infrastructure Fund is an official agriculture-finance programme. For current eligibility, eligible projects, financing terms, application process and implementing-institution requirements, consult its official portal and applicable guidelines. Cooperative Mitra does not assess projects, promise financing, or submit applications.

title: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY) — official reference
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
content: PMKSY is an agriculture and irrigation programme. Components and implementation can be location-specific. Consult the official programme portal and the responsible State or district department for current component availability, eligibility, assistance and application procedure.

title: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY) — official reference
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
content: RKVY is an official agriculture-development programme implemented through approved plans and relevant authorities. Current projects, assistance and eligibility must be checked with the official RKVY portal and the concerned State agriculture department.

title: National Food Security Mission (NFSM) — official reference
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
content: NFSM is an official agriculture programme. Programme activities, crops, assistance and local availability must be verified from the current official NFSM information and relevant implementing authority before a farmer relies on them.
